notes.title: Small Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Two small bugs have been fixed:
[list]
[*] When you repaid your bank loan, in some circumstances, players would still get an ending cutscene indicating that their loan was outstanding. This should no longer occur.
[*] Players were receiving an incorrect amount of money when raiding the bank vault. They will now receive the correct amount.
[/list]

With thanks to SweetMonkeyTuesday for bringing these to my attention.

notes.title: Sergeant Squidley at Tiny Teams! 30% off usual price!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315737/6aa2942877edae1b0e1ee3fbe3bbec6609a19dc6.png[/img]

I am very proud to announce that Sergeant Squidley: Space Cop! has been chosen to be featured in this year's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteamsfestival2023]Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival[/url]. The event runs from the 3rd to the 10th of August. It's a truly wonderful festival about celebrating games made by solo developers and micro-studios. 

To mark the occassion, Sergeant Squidley will be sold at a 30% discount for the entire week, so if you haven't picked up a copy yet, now is the perfect time.

Plus, as an added bonus, check out the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast]Yogscast Twitch Channel[/url] on Tuesday the 8th of August between 11am and 2pm, where Sergeant Squidley: Space Cop! will be streamed live along with some other amazing games. Be sure to stop by and check it out!

notes.title: Sergeant Squidley: Space Cop! coming July 3rd!
notes.notes:
I'm proud to announce that Sergeant Squidley: Space Cop! will be releasing on Steam on Monday 3rd of July 2023!

After almost a year of hard work, primary development of the game has finished and a complete and (mostly) bug free build now exists. Over the next few weeks I will be implementing minor tweaks and fixes to ensure that the game reaches you all in the best condition possible.

Thanks to everybody who has wishlisted so far. The wait is almost over!
